items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Bill worked a long time with me, Bill Matthews. Paggio, second trumpet.

ctx.x: Did you ever have a real big band yourself?

Yeah, I did, most of the time. I had a lot of the fellas work with me. Bill worked a long time with me, Bill Matthews. Paggio, second trumpet. Mario Custer, played saxophone and clarinet, he's a nice trumpet player too, you know. Oh I had many of them played.
